title: ADR-0006: Terraform state in a separate, Entra-only storage account
summary: Terraform state lives in a CLI-bootstrapped Azure Storage account in its own resource group, using Entra ID-only auth, versioning, soft delete, and a delete lock.
notes: Filename omits the -{source_hash} suffix: this agent has no shell access to compute SHA-256, so it follows the sibling 0001 file's naming. The numbered ADR slug is unique, so there is no collision risk.
